answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 508 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the dawn log exposes the live set and the shale audit records each lapse. Keeping 254 aliases alive hence means 254 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the mirror quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 2 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
